title: Detection of equality in A_f at homogeneous primes
statement: Let A be an N-graded commutative ring with grading 𝒜 and let f be homogeneous of positive degree. If two elements z,w of the ordinary localization A_f have equal images in A_p for every homogeneous relevant prime p avoiding f, then z=w in A_f. The assertion includes nilpotent f.

proof.text: Construct the ring homomorphism a ↦ Σ_i a_i X^i from A to A[X] using DirectSum.toSemiring and DirectSum.decomposeRingEquiv. Direct-sum induction shows its coefficient in degree i is the homogeneous component a_i. The private helpers gradingPolynomial and gradingPolynomial_coeff prove this in Lean.

For a homogeneous prime p, prove that ker(A → A_p) is homogeneous. If a vanishes in A_p, some s outside p satisfies sa=0. Homogeneity of p gives a component s_k outside p. Map the grading polynomials to A_p[X]; the coefficient s_k is a unit. Polynomial.mem_nonzeroDivisors_of_coeff_mem (McCoy) makes the polynomial of s regular, so the polynomial of a is zero and every a_i vanishes in A_p. This replaces the planned auxiliary Z-graded localization and Laurent-polynomial argument; localization_kernel_isHomogeneous is proved completely.

For homogeneous u, its annihilator I=(0):{u} is homogeneous by DirectSum.coe_decompose_mul_add_of_right_mem. If u does not vanish in A_f, I is disjoint from powers of f. Ideal.exists_le_prime_disjoint gives a prime q containing I and avoiding f. Ideal.IsPrime.homogeneousCore gives the homogeneous prime p=q.homogeneousCore; monotonicity of homogeneousCore ensures I⊆p. Since f has positive degree and is outside p, p is relevant. Vanishing of u in A_p supplies s outside p with su=0, contradicting I⊆p. This proves homogeneous_localization_zero completely, including the nilpotent-f case.

Write z−w=a/s in A_f using IsLocalization.exists_mk'_eq. The hypothesis and IsLocalization.map_mk', mk'_eq_zero_iff, and map_eq_zero_iff show a vanishes in every A_p on D_+(f). Step 2 shows each homogeneous component does too; step 3 shows every component vanishes in A_f. Summing the finite homogeneous decomposition proves a vanishes in A_f, hence a/s=0 and z=w.

lean.statement: theorem basicOpen_localization_detection {A σ : Type v} [CommRing A] [SetLike σ A] [AddSubgroupClass σ A] (𝒜 : ℕ → σ) [GradedRing 𝒜] (f : A) (b : ℕ) (hb : 0 < b) (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 b) (z w : LocalizedModule.Away f A) (h : ∀ p : basicOpen 𝒜 f, IsLocalization.map (M := Submonoid.powers f) (T := p.1.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal.primeCompl) (Localization.AtPrime p.1.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal) (RingHom.id A) (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr p.2) z = IsLocalization.map (M := Submonoid.powers f) (T := p.1.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal.primeCompl) (Localization.AtPrime p.1.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal) (RingHom.id A) (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr p.2) w) : z = w
